authority: U19: observe neurons during actual tasks and responses. U20: share tools. U21: compact storage.
question: What native post-gating channel activity and raw/normalized MLP-update magnitudes occur at fixed prompt and response positions on every adequate-output native trajectory?
representation: Pinned text-only BF16. Same structural coordinates do not prove feature alignment or an exact common training ancestor. No adapters.
panel: All96 N37 logical outcomes:48original and48compatible donor, each32coding across8dependent families plus16retention. No selection by correctness. Existing grades stay on host and are carried, never recomputed.
replay: For each full native response, make exactly one fresh-cache prefill and G-1 cached forwards, G being its completed token count. At every decision require the same unprocessed greedy argmax, full-FP32-logit hash and WHOLE raw-cache hash as that model own recorded trajectory. Feed its actual verified argmax to the next step. Emit zero new tokens. Stop on any mismatch, no tolerance change or new baseline.
token_alignment: Prefill prompt positions process actual prompt input tokens, not generated output. Only the final prompt position predicts generated token0. Cached response decisionj>0 processes generated tokenj-1 and predicts generated tokenj. Do not label the supplied next prompt token as a model prediction.

sampling.prompt_positions: At most8 uniformly spaced integer positions, floor(i*(n-1)/(m-1)) for i=0..m-1,m=min(8,n),or[0]ifn=1. Include endpoints.
sampling.decision_positions: At most32 uniformly spaced decisions using the same integer formula,m=min(32,G),include0andG-1. Do not duplicate the final prompt position at decision0.
sampling.toplist_decisions: Sorted unique {0,(G-1)//2,G-1}. At each, report per-layer top8 by abs(h_j)*FP32norm(down_column_j), descending then channel index. Observational candidates only, no edit or role selection.

coordinates.method: Union of existing N20 selected64 and two random64 groups, three prior chat-unit coordinates, then eight additional fixed distinct random coordinates per layer seeded5201+layer. No activity/outcome ranking for the timeline. Random coverage is not activity-matched on this new panel.

measurements.hook_scope: Read-only native down_proj-input h, raw down_proj output and post_feedforward_layernorm output. No attention/cache/weight edits. No tensors saved in full.
measurements.timeline: At each sampled token save471actual signed h values, per-layer h mean/RMS/max-absolute, raw down-output L2 and post-FFN-normalized-update L2. Save fixed unit output-column norms and actual argmax probability/log-probability at decision positions. Other prompt positions have no predicted probability.
measurements.moments: Accumulate per-channel signed mean, mean absolute value and mean square across every native decision, excluding extra interior-prompt samples. Use F64 accumulation from actual BF16 values. Save case-balanced averages across48cases per model, each trajectory first divided by its own decision count; also fixed-group/family summaries and each case top16 by RMS*down-column norm. These are measured summary statistics, not fitted/applied vectors.
measurements.limits: The raw column-weighted magnitude is before normalization, not normalized residual contribution, mediation or causal influence. Compare different native trajectories descriptively; they do not share the same generated history. Host audits schema, lineage hashes/counters and saved arithmetic, not full pretrained activations or weights.
measurements.storage: Compressed per-case NPZ arrays plus compact metadata JSONL and model-level moments. At most64MiB total scientific outputs; full activations and weights ephemeral, caches/tmp. Viewer JSON generated locally from one selected trace on request, never automatically public.

counter_contract.formula: Per completed trajectory with inputn andGdecisions: callsG, exposuresn+G-1. No extra pretrained control forwards, generations or scorer runs. Every decision is checked against its frozen own-history reference.

identity_guards: Observer must visit every declared native layer exactly once per forward with exact declared sequence/width. Refuse missing/duplicate/nonfinite observations and malformed coordinates. Always remove hooks on success or error.
Both pretrained checkpoint source hashes/parameter scope and tokenizer exact. No full transformerlayers,new neurons,learned bridge,strength search or new donor selection.

Actual random Gemma FP32/BF16fixtures independently compare observer values with direct read-only capture and raw/postnorm norms; compare full logits/cache/generation identity and state; exercise bad shape,duplicate coordinate,nonfinite/corrupt lineage and cleanup.
Import actual runner and auditor, RuffF821/F823, all96tokenization/lineage contracts, isolated compressed transport. Freeze source/data/auditor beforeGPU.
analysis: Show all96cases and all10families, including wrong programs. Report coverage, numerical distributions, signs, fixed-group statistics and cross-model descriptions with family dependence. No semantic labels, causal claims, coding gain, formal feature alignment or complete map from these observations. A subsequent direct causal protocol must freeze candidates,matchedcontrols,zero/donor/self/rescue and fresh utility separately.
publication: Only reviewed generic observer/viewer code, aggregate methodology, nonreconstructive aggregate figures and statistics. Raw task/reply/activation timelines stay private. No model-edit recipe exists because observation changes no model.
edition: Reviewed prospective observation methods. Raw lineages and traces remain private. No pretrained outcome is implied.
